prompt: When a key is used, the cache moves it to the most-recent end of the list. Complete the two steps: take the key out of its old position, then put it at the back.
explain: `remove(pos)` takes the element out of the middle and returns it, and `push` appends it at the end, so the front stays the least recently used. `pop` takes no index, and `Vec` has no `push_front`.
